question: What are some basic flight safety practices emphasized during initial flight training?
What is the primary concept set forth by 14 CFR part 91 to prevent midair collisions?

correct_answers.text: All pilots should be alert to the potential for midair collision and impending loss of separation.

The general operating and flight rules in 14 CFR part 91 set forth the concept of “see and avoid.” This concept requires that vigilance shall be maintained at all times by each person operating an aircraft regardless of whether the operation is conducted under IFR or VFR.
